scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
50 Jellopies and 20,000 zeny are all you need to get special effect on your green onion or carrot!
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
50个杰勒比结晶和20,000 Zeny，就能给你的大葱或胡萝卜附加特殊效果！

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
Enchant and reset have ^ff000030% of failure.^000000 Invest in your veggie and luck!
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
附魔和重置都有^ff000030%的失败率^000000。投资你的蔬菜和运气吧！

scripts.text: How much do I need to enchant?
scripts.translation: 附魔需要多少钱？

scripts.text: Enchant to Poring Village Veggie
scripts.translation: 附魔波利村蔬菜

scripts.text: Reset Poring Village Veggie
scripts.translation: 重置波利村蔬菜

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
As I heard, you can get Poring Village Green Onion or Carrot if you go west a bit more from here.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
我听说，从这里再往西走一点，就能找到波利村的大葱或胡萝卜。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
I do enchant to the fresh vegetable.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
我对新鲜的蔬菜进行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
Enchant or Reset requires 20,000z and 50 Jellopy! It's not bad, is it?
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
附魔或重置需要20,000 Zeny和50个杰勒比结晶！这价格不贵吧？

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
Well... As you know, it's a vegetable any way. So sometimes it can be broken.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
嗯...你知道的，毕竟它只是蔬菜。所以有时候会坏掉。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
Please put on the equipment you'd like to enchant first.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
请先装备好你要附魔的装备。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
This is not a vegetable!?
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
这不是蔬菜！？

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
This vegetable cannot be enchanted anymore.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
这个蔬菜无法再附魔了。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
This enchant requires 50 Jellopy and 20,000z..... But... you don't have them.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
这次附魔需要50个杰勒比结晶和20,000 Zeny...但是...你没有。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
Tada! Enchant is done! Check your vegetable.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
看！附魔完成了！检查一下你的蔬菜吧。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
It must have been a rotten vegetable. It's a shame that I can't stand this level of power...
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
那一定是个腐朽的蔬菜。真遗憾，我承受不了这么强的力量...

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
Please put on the equipment you'd like to enchant first.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
请先装备好你要附魔的装备。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
This is not a vegetable!?
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
这不是蔬菜！？

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
This is a vegetable that has never been fortified...
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
这是一颗从未被强化的蔬菜...

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
This enchant requires 50 Jellopy and 20,000z..... But... you don't have them.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
这次附魔需要50个杰勒比结晶和20,000 Zeny...但是...你没有。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
The item is complete! Check it out.
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
物品完成了！看看效果吧。

scripts.text:
[Veggie Enchanter]
It must have been a rotten vegetable. It's a shame that I can't stand this level of power...
scripts.translation:
[蔬菜附魔师]
那一定是个腐朽的蔬菜。真遗憾，我承受不了这么强的力量...

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Wow~ You look like a novice. I do want to adventure with you someday when you grow up!
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
哇~你看起来像个初心者。等你长大一点，我很想和你一起冒险！

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Oh, now you are stronger than me. How did you grow so fast?
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
哦，现在你比我强了。你怎么长得这么快？

scripts.text:
[Emily]
I should find another adventurer who is similar with my level. It's been nice knowing you.
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
我应该找个和我等级差不多的冒险者。很高兴认识你。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
My name is Emily. I was waiting for someone who will go on adventures with me!
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
我叫艾米丽。我一直在等一个愿意和我一起冒险的人！

scripts.text: Who said I will adventure with you?
scripts.translation: 谁说要和你一起冒险了？

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Well, come one. Don't be stern. Listen, you can decide after listening to my story. Of course, I can give you a proper reward.
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
哎呀，别这么严肃嘛。听我说，听完我的故事你再决定也不迟。当然，我会给你一份像样的报酬。

scripts.text: Proper Reward?
scripts.translation: 像样的报酬？

scripts.text: I'm not interested.
scripts.translation: 我不感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
How square! It's much better to be together!
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
真无趣！在一起冒险不是更好吗！

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Yes! Proper Reward.
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
对！像样的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
It seems this Poring Village can be defeated by beginners just like us. It's just a wild guess though...
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
看来这个波利村对我们这种初学者来说也能轻松搞定。当然，这只是我的猜测...

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Well, actually I cannot give you the reward officially through adventurer association. But we can separate the income after hunting.
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
嗯，其实我不能通过冒险者协会正式支付报酬。不过我们可以打完怪后分账。

scripts.text: But 50-50 sounds fair to me.
scripts.translation: 不过五五分成听起来挺公平的。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
No way. 70-30. And I'm 70 of course.
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
没门。七三分。当然，我拿七成。

scripts.text: It's gotta be 50-50 or it's no good
scripts.translation: 必须是五五分成，否则免谈

scripts.text:
[Emily]
How about 60-40!!
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
那...六四分成！！
五五分成...

scripts.text:
[Emily]
This drives me crazy. OK, 50-50. Let's go with this.
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
真是拿你没办法。好吧，五五分成。就这么定了。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
So, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
那么，你准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Emily]
You look very tired.
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
你看起来很累。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Why don't you come back after a while? Take a break for now.
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
不如你先休息一下，过一会儿再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
So, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
那么，你准备好了吗？

scripts.translation: ^0000ff“波利村”任务的所有痕迹已被清除。现在，请再次与艾米丽对话以进入。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emily]
So, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
那么，你准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Hmm you should create a party first to start this grand adventure.
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
嗯，你应该先创建一个队伍，才能开始这场伟大的冒险。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Now I'm looking for the entrance, please talk to me again after it's totally open.
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
现在我在寻找入口，等它完全打开后，请再和我说话。

scripts.text: An unknown error occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个未知错误。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Time's crack is not created yet.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000时间的裂缝尚未生成。^000000

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Let's go forward.
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
让我们前进吧。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
I'm going to start slowly now...
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
我现在要慢慢开始了...

scripts.text:
[Emily]
You can have all of the items you find in this dungeon. I already have some.
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
在这个副本里找到的所有物品都可以归你所有。我已经有一些了。

scripts.text:
[Emily]
Ah, I found some items. Let me give you one of them. Just to celebrate your first visit!
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
啊，我找到了一些物品。让我给你其中一个吧。就当是庆祝你的首次访问！

scripts.text:
[Emily]
I don't need this novice box. You can take it. Now, let's go out side!
scripts.translation:
[艾米丽]
我不需要这个初心者盒子。你可以拿走它。现在，让我们出去吧！
